admitted: fixed rectangular compatible MAC pressure operator only

timing_protocol.scope: Complete pressure stage kick, divergence, solve and projection. Allocation/planning/build separately excluded. Not full fluid cost.
timing_protocol.sensitivity: Small tank half timestep, and one-second horizon if bounded runtime permits.
